name: Attention-value FFT phase jitter
plain: An attention replacement that randomises phase in the FFT of the attention values, tilted by frequency. It belongs with patches by hook, but the maths is a frequency method. Fresh torch.rand per call, not seeded by a widget.
math:
r=clamp(2√(ft²+fd²),0,1); w=r^tilt if tilt>0, (1−r)^−tilt if tilt<0
per_frequency: φ=U·2π·strength·w; V*=e^{iφ}; v=real(ifft2 V)
then optimized_attention(q,k,v)
label: from code
